# Phyrexian Arena (FDN), an enchantment for {1}{B}{B}.
# "At the beginning of your upkeep, you draw a card and lose 1 life."
# Event: the compiler's own "At the beginning of your upkeep" (frame B13-upkeep: TurnPhaseEvent
#   UPKEEP with actor CONTROLLER_IS YOU; `parse "At the beginning of your upkeep, draw a card."`).
# Effect: M20 Audacious Thief's verified "you draw a card and you lose 1 life" (a Seq in printed
#   order: DRAW 1 then LOSE_LIFE 1, both YOU); Wardens of the Cycle's mapped mode is the same.
# The compiled cast carrier (SpellAbility ENCHANTMENT) is kept as it is.
upkeep = TriggeredAbility(
    event=TurnPhaseEvent(
        phase=Phase.UPKEEP,
        actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=Seq(
        steps=(
            A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
            A(Verb.LOSE_LIFE, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
        ),
    ),
)
abilities = [upkeep, *compiled]

clauses.clause: At the beginning of your upkeep, you draw a card and lose 1 life.
